decisions.reason: Because of the firm's long investment and public commitment to this product, management continues to justify its earlier decision and persists despite any early disappointments.

Although it is less publicly visible and less central to the announced direction, it builds on the established offer and its recent launch still allows management to attribute weak results to temporary causes.
The secure messaging service is highly visible with its own page and central to the firm's announced digital, paperless health-IT direction, so escalation pressure keeps it on the market.
